title: JESUS the friend of sinners died

lines.text: JESUS the friend of sinners died The Children of Salem doth weep Thick darkness sets and veils the skies And suddenly, the earth did quake.
Behold the mercy and the love Of the king of glory for man Behold what joy doth come our way Jesus who died doth rise again.
Then, fear ye not, O saints of God Tell how the Lord our King doth reign Sing of His victory o‘er the foe Tell now He met and conquered death.
Proclaim: “Thou art our king for aye" Thou who art born to save us all Ask death and say "where is thy sting? And grave, “where is thy victory".
